name: gymflow-native
description: Capacitor Android shell for the GymFlow PWA. Kept out of the app root so the web app stays build-step free.

scripts.sync: node sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.add:android: node sync-web.mjs && npx cap add android
scripts.build:debug: node sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: node sync-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
